ALTER TABLE nexus.catalog_links ADD CONSTRAINT fk_catalog_links_to_document FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, to_tumbler) REFERENCES nexus.catalog_documents (tenant_id, tumbler) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE NOT VALID;

changeSet.author: nexus-tk070.p1
changeSet.comment: Delete every catalog_links row whose from_tumbler OR to_tumbler has no matching nexus.catalog_documents row for that tenant_id — an anti-join against the document store (F17), never a count comparison. RLS toggle-wrapped (nexus-1wjmq shape): both catalog_links and nexus.catalog_documents carry FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and Liquibase's nexus_admin owner is not BYPASSRLS, so both are toggled off for the read/delete and restored before this changeset ends. RDR-194 § D2 requires the affected rows to be EXPORTED to the run log BEFORE the delete (bounded to the first 200, with the total count), not just a post-delete count, so the loss is bounded, visible, and auditable. Both the export RAISE NOTICEs and the final deleted-count RAISE NOTICE are captured by Liquibase's JdbcExecutor from the JDBC Statement's SQLWarning chain and logged through its own (SLF4J-backed) logger by default (SHOW_SQL_WARNING_MESSAGES defaults true) — no runAlways, no DDL-in-Python, no bespoke Java capture.

changeSet.comment: VALIDATE fk_catalog_links_from_document — retroactively check pre-existing rows now that catalog-032-1 has remediated any dangling population. Guarded by a whole-changeset precondition (nexus-4m6i0.13/nexus-ms57z shape 1, same as catalog-029-2's own), covering ONLY this constraint (per-constraint coverage, not per-changeset — tests/test_changelog_validate_precondition_lint.py): skips (marks ran, once) instead of hard-ERRORing a crash-loop boot on any box where the constraint doesn't exist. All four catalog-032 changesets ship together in one file/release, so this guard is expected to be a permanent no-op in practice (catalog-032-0 always runs first in the same walk) — it is added purely to satisfy the project's blanket "every bare VALIDATE CONSTRAINT is guarded" tripwire, which does not carve out a same-release exception.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE nexus.catalog_links VALIDATE CONSTRAINT fk_catalog_links_from_document;
